hack.root_cause: Illiquid collateral oracle manipulation — single USTRY/USDC trade pumped price 100x → inflated collateral → undercollateralized borrow drain
hack.description: A single trade on a market with under $1/hour in volume pumped USTRY's price 100x, and Blend V2's oracle accepted it as truth — letting the attacker borrow $10.97M against $160K of real collateral.
